label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 27
title: MVP: dashboard must depict the canonical E2E pipeline workflow + orchestrate all CLI parameters in UI
body:
Owner requirement: the dashboard UI must faithfully depict the E2E workflow from docs/PIPELINE-WORKFLOW-CORRECTED.md so it matches the backend, and must orchestrate ALL parameters of scripts/run_pipeline.py and scripts/pipeline.py (and run_portfolio.py, approve.py, core.interactive) on proper pages/components.
Workflow views: Pipeline Workflow (32-stage DAG, live status colors); Stage/Agent detail (agents, inputs/outputs, gate, artifacts, duration, tokens, logs); phase panels 4a/4b/4c + VQA with the code-review-after-each-phase + fix->validate loop; Test Results per phase/feature; Architecture; Live Data (WebSocket); Final Summary. Rule enforced: human approves after EVERY agent (auto mode = human-proxy).
Parameter orchestration: new/continue/enhance; --control stop|pause|resume; --from-stage/--only-stage/--only/--agent (rerun/retry); --tier/--tier-list/--tier-info; --step/--interactive/--auto; approve/reject; interactive answer; and the pipeline.py ops subcommands (list, agents, runs, test, health, checkpoints, dlq, usage, architecture, continue, queue, queue-add, budget, status, circuit-reset, lock, unlock, version, log, review, ledger, skills, report, models) - one Ops page per subcommand.
Extends BI-0018 (depict configs + script parameters + controls).
